digest.component_or_area: PydanticAIRunner.run() method in llm runner module
propositions: Extract build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, and record_call_spend from PydanticAIRunner.run() into new module src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py as plain functions with explicit parameters and no carrier object.
Reduce PydanticAIRunner.run() from 342 lines to under 300 lines and src/rebar/llm/runner.py from 699 to under 658 lines by moving four kwargs fragments and post-call telemetry blocks.
Keep _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site in runner.py to preserve monkeypatch.setattr effectiveness and pass web_caps as a parameter to build_agent_kwargs.
Ensure agent_call.py clears the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor per AGENTS.md while respecting the 800-LOC authoritative ceiling from .github/module-size-limit.txt.
All existing tests must pass unedited; zero monkeypatch repoints required; new seam test must validate structure and edge cases (empty usage dict, falsy model_settings, tool_step_limit filtering).
Preserve all relocated comments without losing measured numbers, file:line citations, bug/story/epic ids, failure modes, or stated invariants.
